items.title: Properness of relative cycles satisfies h-descent
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（20 行证明）、proper 相对循环的 h 下降：正向函子性一句话；反向仿射局部化、细化到单个 proper 满态射、支撑引理搬 proper 性到支撑逆像闭包、proper 传递、闭像引理得包含支撑的 proper 闭集收尾（末步由定义一句话）。3 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-proper-h-descent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2127-2134

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Deduce the forward direction from functoriality of properness under base change, and for the converse work affine locally on the base, refine the h covering to a single proper surjective morphism from a scheme with an open covering whose members carry the properness, transfer properness of the pulled back cycle to properness over the base of the closure of the inverse image of the support using the support compatibility under the pullback, propagate properness along the proper covering morphism by transitivity, and conclude that the image of that closure, a closed subset proper over the base containing the support, forces the cycle to be proper (source lines 2136-2155)
